title: Check-in code
description: Show this code to the kiosk camera to check in.
help: Turn up your screen brightness if the kiosk doesn't read the code.
inactive: There is no active check-in code. Create one to check in with the kiosk camera.
confirmBody: The current code stops working straight away, including any printed or saved copy. Use this if the code was shared or a device was lost.
error: We couldn't load the check-in code. Please try again.
unavailable: Check-in codes aren't available right now. Please ask the front desk.
conflict: The code changed on another device. The latest code is shown; try again if you still want to replace it.
